template.name: Metro Boomin
template.about: Dark minor bells and choirs, distorted 808 with glide, hat rolls, big reverb.

project.name: Metro Boomin
project.notes:
METRO BOOMIN  (2014-today)

TECHNIQUE (sourced)
- FL Studio is the main program; he also has an MPC2000XL (eight outputs, into Pro Tools), an
  SP-1200 and a TR-808 (Sound On Sound, "Inside Track: Heroes & Villains", 2023).
- Started on FruityLoops (RBMA lecture). Starts with synths or chords, "never really drums
  first", and avoids samples (Vice/Noisey).
- "Dark minor melodies" and "reverb-heavy" as his stated method: unconfirmed.

THIS TEMPLATE
Bells, choir and dark keys first (Metro's order), then the 808 (Surge XT "Sub 2", glide,
built-in Overdrive) and drums (The drum rack plays one-shots synthesized for these templates (CC0, no recordings), in the voice of the machine each channel is named for, with a starter beat in the pattern; replace them with your own samples for the real machine.). Music Bus has ValhallaSupermassive at 25% for size;
the vocal has Pro Wave Tune "Hard Tune (trap)".

MIX NOTES
- 808 and kick: pick one to own 40-60 Hz per hit; distortion on the 808 for small speakers.
- Master: built-in glue, Lemon Soft Clipper, Lemon Limiter +6 dB at -0.5 dB; -7 to -5 LUFS working
  target.
- Loudness: streaming plays back near -14 LUFS integrated (Spotify), so a louder master is turned down; keep true peak below -1 dBTP.

COVERAGE
Good. No MPC2000XL or SP-1200 model; the drums are synthesized one-shots, not samples of the machines.

SOURCES
Sound On Sound "Inside Track: Metro Boomin" (2023); RBMA lecture Metro Boomin / Sonny Digital /
Zaytoven; Vice/Noisey Metro Boomin interview; Spotify for Artists, "Loudness normalization" (support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization).

FREE PLUG-INS (download them before opening the template; a missing one keeps its slot)
- Surge XT (GPL-3.0): https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/
- OB-Xf (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf
- ValhallaSupermassive (freeware): https://valhalladsp.com/valhallasupermassive/

SETUP (written from this template)
Tempo 140 BPM, 4/4, key Gmin, cycle bars 1-4.

Tracks
- Drums (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Channel Rack (synthesized one-shots of the template samples: Kick (808) = kick-808.wav, Snare (808) = snare-808.wav, Closed Hat (808) = hat-808.wav, Open Hat (808) = openhat-808.wav, Clap (909) = clap.wav, Clap 909 = clap.wav, Open Hat 909 = openhat-909.wav)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -12, Ratio 4, Attack 30, Release 80, Make-up 2)
    region: Step Sequencer pattern with a starter beat (20 steps on), swing 50% (MPC terms), 7 rows = the rack's channels
- 808 (Instrument, -2 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Basses/Sub 2"; A Play Mode 0.5, A Portamento 0.4
    strip FX: Overdrive (Drive 15, Tone 6000, Level -8, Mix 0.5)
- Bells (Instrument, -10 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Mallets/Tubular Bells"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -8 dB
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -16 dB
- Choir (Instrument, -14 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Voices/Choir Aah 2"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -8 dB
- Dark Keys (Instrument, -14 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Keys/Church"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -10 dB
- Lead Vocal (Audio, +0 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    FX: Pro Wave Tune: preset "Hard Tune (trap)" (Retune Speed 0 ms, project key and scale)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -20, Ratio 4, Attack 0.5, Release 60, Make-up 3)
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -16 dB
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -18 dB

Buses (the n-th Aux strip listens to bus n)
- Drum Bus (bus 1): Lemon Soft Clipper: default settings; Compressor (Threshold -16, Ratio 2, Attack 20, Release 300, Make-up 2)
- Music Bus (bus 2): Valhalla DSP, LLC: ValhallaSupermassive: default settings; Mix 0.25, Feedback 0.6, Delay_Ms 0.5, Density 0.6, HighCut 1.0
- Vocal Bus (bus 3): Compressor (Release 150, Make-up 2)
- Reverb (bus 4): Space D (Size 160, Dry -96, Wet 0, Decay 3, Decay Curve 1, IR "03.0s Long Reverb")
- Delay (bus 5): Tape Delay (Time 642.9, Feedback 0.45, Tone 4500, Mix 1)

Stereo Out
- built-in effects: Compressor (Threshold -10, Attack 30, Release 200)
- plug-ins (after the built-in effects): Lemon Soft Clipper: default settings; Lemon Limiter: gain +6 dB, ceiling -0.5 dB, other settings default

Bring your own samples: no recordings are included.
